# Gilbert Blythe

- **Age:** Early twenties  <sub>[v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v3 c1 P15](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0015), [v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome young man with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a frank, straightforward expression. As a boy, he had a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. After his bout with typhoid fever and intensive study at Redmond College, he appeared somewhat thinner and paler, putting his boyhood days behind him for a more mature demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v3 c1 P22](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0022), [v3 c29 P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 c36 P26](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

Gilbert is ambitious, hard-working, and determined, driven by a desire to do honest, meaningful work and add to human knowledge. He possesses a strong sense of duty, a keen intellect, and a mischievous, teasing wit. Highly principled and honourable, he holds a deep respect for women and strives to live up to his high ideals. Though persistent in pursuing his goals, he is capable of great chivalry, self-sacrifice, and patient forgiveness.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v4 c8 P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009), [v4 c29 P10](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0010)_

## History

Gilbert returned to Avonlea School after spending three years in Alberta with his father. On his first day back, he teased new student Anne Shirley by pulling her red hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting her to smash a slate over his head. Though Gilbert immediately apologized, Anne nursed a grudge and refused to speak to him for years, sparking a intense academic rivalry throughout their school days. After graduating from Avonlea School and Queen's Academy, Gilbert taught at the White Sands school for two years, selflessly giving up his application for the Avonlea school so that Anne could remain at Green Gables with Marilla. Later, he attended Redmond College alongside Anne, where he excelled academically, led the Freshman football team to victory, and won the prestigious Cooper Prize and the Senior Class Medal upon graduation. During his Redmond years, he proposed to Anne at Patty's Place but was initially rejected, though he never stopped loving her. After a near-fatal bout with typhoid fever in his final summer, Gilbert and Anne reconciled their feelings upon learning of her love for him. Following his graduation with a B.A. and his medical degree, he accepted his great-uncle's practice at Glen St. Mary and Four Winds Harbor. After a three-year engagement, Gilbert and Anne were married in the orchard at Green Gables.
